svg.title: HealthDataNepal: source systems to approved analytical access

g.text: Care settings create different records at their own event grains.
Incoming records are held and checked
before being trusted as warehouse data.
Records are standardized to refer to
Event facts · Conformed dimensions · Bridges · History
Approved subject datasets and shared definitions
Authorized users ask questions through controlled
SQL Developer · Python · R · Power BI · Reports
Across every layer: governance · security · lineage · quality · monitoring
